PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in": (15.0, 8.0, 20.0),
    "L_in":    (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),
    "gmid_p":  (10.0, 6.0, 14.0),
    "L_p":     (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),
    "gmid_b":  (12.0, 7.0, 16.0),
    "L_b":     (0.5, 0.15, 2.0),
    "Itail":   (3e-6, 1.5e-6, 6e-6),
    "I2":      (5e-6, 2e-6, 8e-6),
    "Wn_inv2": (1.0, 0.42, 3.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-14)
    vod = spec.get("vod", 0.01)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    It, I2 = p["Itail"], p["I2"]

    # input pair (vsb ~ 0.25 V due to tail headroom)
    min_ = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], It / 2, vds=0.6, vsb=0.25)
    # PMOS mirror load and matched stage-2 PMOS (same density -> no systematic offset)
    mld = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L_p"], It / 2, vds=0.8)
    mp2 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L_p"], I2, vds=0.9)
    # NMOS bias mirrors (same gm/Id, L)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmid_b"], p["L_b"], iref, vds=0.6)
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmid_b"], p["L_b"], It, vds=0.25)
    mn2 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_b"], p["L_b"], I2, vds=0.9)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    # stage 1: output o1 on the vinp side, diode on the vinn side
    n.dev("M1", "o1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", min_)
    n.dev("M2", "d1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", min_)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", mld)
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", mld)
    # stage 2: PMOS common source with NMOS current sink
    n.dev("M5", "o2", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", mp2)
    n.dev("M6", "o2", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mn2)
    # inverter 1 (small, light load on o2)
    n.M("MI1N", "o3", "o2", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 0.42, 0.15)
    n.M("MI1P", "o3", "o2", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.84, 0.15)
    # inverter 2 (drives CL)
    wn2 = p["Wn_inv2"]
    n.M("MI2N", "vout", "o3", "vss", "vss", "nfet", wn2, 0.15)
    n.M("MI2P", "vout", "o3", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 2.5 * wn2, 0.15)

    # ---- predictions ----
    gds1 = min_.gds + mld.gds
    A1 = min_.gm / gds1
    C1 = mp2.cgg + min_.cdd + mld.cdd + 1e-15
    tau1 = C1 / gds1
    # single-pole crossing time with the input stepping -vod -> +vod, limited by slew if saturated
    t1 = min(0.7 * tau1, C1 * 0.2 / max(min_.gm * vod, 1e-9) * 0.5)
    cox = 8.5e-15  # F/um^2
    C2 = (0.42 + 0.84) * 0.15 * cox * 1.5 + mp2.cdd + mn2.cdd + 0.5e-15
    t2 = C2 * 0.9 / I2                     # falling o2 limited by the sink current
    C3 = 3.5 * wn2 * 0.15 * cox * 1.5 + 1e-15
    t3 = C3 * 0.9 / 60e-6
    t4 = cl * 0.9 / (2 * 250e-6 * wn2)     # rough inverter-2 drive
    tpd = t1 + t2 + t3 + t4

    power = vdd * (iref + It + I2)
    return n, {"tpd": tpd, "power": power, "offset": 0.0, "polarity_ok": 1,
               "gain1": A1}
